sentences.text:
Applicant :- Sudhir Kumar Goyal And 3 Others
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Rajesh Kumar Mishra

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vikas Budhwar,J.
1. Vakalatnama filed on behalf of Mr. S.V. Dwivedi on behalf of the opposite party no. 2, is taken on
record.

2. Heard Shri Rajesh Kumar Mishra, learned counsel for the applicants and Sri Ashok Kumar Kushwaha, learned AGA for the State-respondent as well as Shri S.V. Dwivedi, counsel for respondent no. 2.
3.

This application under Section 482 Cr.PC. has been filed by the applicant to quash the entire proceedings of Case No. 19778 of 2024 (State Vs. Sudhir Kuamr Goyal and others), arising out of case crime no.0474 of 2024, under Sections 420, 467, 468 IPC Police Station- Kotwali Dehat,
District Bulandshahar pending before the court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bulandshahar.

4. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that the parties have themselves compromised out of Sudhir Kumar Goyal And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 10 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/181229862/
1 the Court on 09.01.2025 (Annexure-1 at page 14) and onwards reference whereof has been made in paragraph no. 4 of the application.

sentences.text:
He submits that the compromise application shall be filed before the court below and interregnum period, subject to verification, in the meantime, till the verification is done, interim protection be accorded.
5.
Learned AGA on the other hand submits that he has no objection to the same.

6. Considering the submissions of the rival parties as well as stand taken by them, the application stands disposed of directing the applicants to approach the Court of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bulandshahar while filing the compromise application and a self-attested copy of the present application by 28.02.2025.
7. On the receipt of the same, the court below shall furnish the compromise so filed by the parties and shall conclude the process for verification by 15.04.2025.

8. Till the disposal of the compromise application, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants in pursuance of Case No. 19778 of 2024 (State Vs. Sudhir Kuamr Goyal and others),
arising out of case crime no.0474 of 2024, under Sections 420, 467, 468 IPC Police Station- Kotwali Dehat, District Bulandshahar pending before the court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Bulandshahar.
